result.title: PCDFusion: Proposal-Context-Detail Bayesian Rendering for Infrared-Visible Image Fusion
result.summary: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) aims to combine visible and thermal infrared observations for human perception and downstream vision tasks. Visible and thermal infrared observations are physically complementary but unreliable in different ways. Existing deep IVIF methods mainly improve feature interaction and reconstruction, but often lack an explicit local rule for deciding when visible appearance should dominate and when thermal responses should contribute. To address this issue, we reformulate IVIF as local Bayesian posterior rendering, where fusion is controlled by posterior action weights rather than direct modality mixing. In this paper, we propose Proposal-Context-Detail Fusion (PCDFusion), a visible-anchored framework that implements this formulation through three rendering stages. PCDFusion preserves potentially useful thermal responses, updates exposure-degraded visible regions, and renders reliable band-limited infrared structures into the final luminance. Extensive experiments on public IVIF benchmarks show that PCDFusion improves fusion quality, target recovery, and downstream detection and segmentation performance under challenging illumination. The code is available at https://github.com/BIT-RuiLiu/PCDFusion.git.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PCDFusion，把红外-可见光图像融合重写为局部贝叶斯后验渲染，用后验动作权重而非直接模态混合来控制三阶段融合。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是像素级图像融合与重建质量提升，不涉及 VLM 的内部推理状态、视觉证据筛选或解码决策；「后验动作权重」仅是渲染层面的模态配比，未形成可供 LVR 核查的状态或证据机制线索。
